name: demo-v1
description: 125 questions over the three demo companies (Nimbus Infotech, Sanjeevani Pharma, Kaveri Capital), written alongside the documents (demo_corpus/eval_candidates) and checked against the sources. A question counts as retrieved when a chunk from doc containing evidence (case-insensitive) is among the top k. not_found questions must get 'not found'; a question with denied_as is also asked as that user, who must get 'not found' and never the document.

questions.q: How many days of privilege leave do Kaveri Capital employees get per calendar year?
questions.evidence: 20 days of privilege leave
questions.answer: 20 days of privilege leave per calendar year (plus 8 casual and 10 sick leave days).

questions.q: How long must the mandatory block leave be for dealers and fund managers, and why is it required?
questions.evidence: 10 consecutive working days
questions.answer: 10 consecutive working days every calendar year; it is a fraud-control measure so that someone else runs their book while they are away.

questions.q: What is the minimum holding period for personal trades by Kaveri employees?
questions.evidence: 30-day minimum holding
questions.answer: 30 days from the trade date, after pre-clearance.

questions.q: Within what time must a personal trading violation be reported, and to whom?
questions.evidence: reported to the CCO within 1 working day
questions.answer: To the Chief Compliance Officer within 1 working day of discovery.

questions.q: If an employee sells shares 20 days after buying them without a hardship exception, what happens to the profit, and what is the penalty if it happens again within 24 months?
questions.evidence: Any profit from a sale within 30 days without an exception is disgorged to the Company's CSR fund
questions.answer: The profit is disgorged to the Company's CSR fund; a repeat within 24 months leads to a 6-month personal trading suspension.

questions.q: What is the hotel limit per night in Mumbai for a G3 employee?
questions.answer: ₹8,500 per night, excluding taxes.

questions.q: What is the largest holding of the Kaveri Bluechip Fund as of March 2026 and its weight?
questions.evidence: Sahyadri Bank Ltd
questions.answer: Sahyadri Bank Ltd at 8.9% of net assets.

questions.answer: 22.4% (direct plan) against 24.8% for the Nifty Smallcap 250 TRI, an underperformance of 2.4 percentage points.

questions.answer: 6.94% (annualised), as of 31 March 2026.

questions.answer: 1.0% per annum management fee plus 20% of returns above a 10% hurdle, subject to a high-water mark (the alternative is a 2.0% fixed fee).

questions.answer: 26,800, based on 18.5x forward earnings on September 2027E Nifty EPS of ₹1,450.

questions.answer: The Small Cap fund was to exit its entire Vindhyagiri Cementworks position due to governance concerns, in an orderly way by 15 May 2026, and the stock was put on the do-not-buy list for at least 24 months.

questions.q: How many days of unused earned leave can a Nimbus employee carry forward into the next year?
questions.evidence: up to 30 days of unused earned leave are carried forward
questions.answer: Up to 30 days; earned leave beyond 30 days lapses on 31 March.

questions.q: How often must Kaveri re-do KYC for high-risk clients?
questions.doc: KYC and Customer Due Diligence Policy
questions.evidence: Every 2 years
questions.answer: Every 2 years for high-risk clients.

questions.q: Within how many working days must site QA approve the initial assessment of a major deviation?
questions.evidence: Initial assessment approved by site QA within 3 working days
questions.answer: Within 3 working days, with closure targeted within 30 calendar days.
